content:
Hi all, I just opened a PR on partial types: #36719.

The PR introduces PartialType over a theory and PartialTypeOver over a parameter set, and proves several equivalent characterizations. My following work is to connect PartialType with CompleteType.

A few notes for reviewers:

  • Almost all of the names and docstrings in this PR were drafted with LLM. If any names feel non-idiomatic, or any docstrings are unclear, suggestions for renaming or rewording would be very welcome.
  • Not every proof has been fully golfed. In some places I was worried that further golfing would hurt readability, even though some proofs are still fairly verbose. If anyone sees a cleaner argument, I would be very happy to modify mine.
  • During the proof, most minor but tedious issues are caused by language shifting, including manually providing some type class instances. I wonder whether type synonyms could help make this smoother; for related context, see #33458.

Comments on the API, naming, proof style, and the longer-term direction are all very welcome.

Ping. Just a note that a small prerequisite PR #36667 probably needs review first. Additionally, I've already finished the API connecting PartialTypes and CompleteTypes. Once these two PRs make some progress, I can open the follow-up PR immediately.
